title: fix(plugin-detail): a record page's body table wider than the details column pins its first column and offers ⤢ as "All columns"
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBPcWUCKqwQ3ME7VAmfuaJqh)_

Fixes #29945

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：记录页正文子表（详情列里的关联列表）列太多、超出详情列宽度时，现在会明确提示：首列（记录名）横向滚动时固定不动；表头右上角的放大按钮从只有图标变成带文字的「全部列」按钮；右侧阴影（18.3 已有）照旧随滚动位置出现和消失。表格放得下时以上提示都不出现。
- **为什么改**：hotclm 的合同子表有 7、8 列，在 1440 宽的页面上只露出 4、5 列，读者看不出右边还有列（滚动条悬停才出现，右侧阴影很淡）。表格仍留在详情列里，不跨到右侧栏：ADR-0085 的按角色分栏布局决定了正文表的位置，改栅格会动所有记录页的列布局，归 ADR-0085 §5 / epic #26676，不在本卡范围。
- **风险与回滚**：只在「正文子表且确实溢出」时改变外观；`data-table` 表头标签多了一个 `title`（所有表格都有，悬停显示完整列名），滚动容器多一个 `data-table-scroll-box` 标记属性。新增一个 i18n 键（10 个语言）。不加 spec 键、不改布局；回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx` 中 `bodyTableOverflows` 的读数 effect 和放大按钮的两种形态；`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx` 的两处属性；测试 `RelatedList.bodyTable-27055.test.tsx` 新增的 objectstack#29945 用例组。
- **两分钟验证**：在仓根运行 `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.bodyTable-27055.test.tsx`，预期 15 个测试全部通过（8 列：有阴影、首列 sticky、放大按钮带文字；滚到末尾阴影消失；3 列放得下：三者皆无）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The seat's ruling for this card keeps the record page v3 grid (ADR-0085's role-based layout puts body tables in the details column) and makes the overflow obvious instead. A body table (`bodyTable` in `RelatedList`, a related list in `RecordBodyTablesContext`) now reads whether it is wider than its column, and while it is:

| Cue | Before (18.3.0) | After |
|---|---|---|
| Right-edge shadow while columns remain to the right | drawn by `data-table` (objectui#12708); clears at the end | unchanged, reused |
| First (identity) column | scrolls away | pinned: the table's existing `frozenColumns: 1`, set only while the table overflows |
| ⤢ enlarge control | icon-only ghost button | outline button with a visible label, `detail.relatedCardAllColumns` ("All columns" / 「全部列」); same `enlargeRelated` call, same enlarged tab |
| Header label the ellipsis would cut | no full text | `title` with the whole label (every `data-table`, see below) |

A body table that fits shows none of these: no pinned column, the icon-only ⤢ (`aria-label` "Enlarge"), and `data-table` draws no shadow.

**How overflow is read.** `RelatedList` wraps the table in a host `div` and, in a layout effect, finds the table's scroll box by a new `data-table-scroll-box` marker and reads `scrollWidth - clientWidth > 1`, re-read by a `ResizeObserver` on the box and on its `table` (rows arriving, columns sizing themselves). If the table mounts after the list (a deferred renderer) a `MutationObserver` waits for the box, then disconnects. The effect is keyed on primitives only (`bodyTableDrawn`, `isMobile`; ui/AGENTS.md commandment 10). Under 768 px the body table is the card gallery and reads `false`. The PM's mechanism assumption holds: overflow is detectable from the scroll container with a `ResizeObserver`, and jsdom has no layout, so the tests stub the widths.

**No new scroll-shadow or sticky utility.** The shadow is `data-table`'s own (from `custom/use-horizontal-overflow`), the pin is `data-table`'s `frozenColumns`. Neither was changed.

**`@object-ui/components`, two attributes on `data-table`.** (1) the header label `span` carries `title={col.header}`. This reaches every `data-table`, not only body tables (a non-body-table header case is pinned, below). (2) the scroll box carries `data-table-scroll-box=""` for a host that reads its overflow. In a table's auto layout a header cell is never narrower than its nowrap label, so (1) is the hover fallback for the ellipsis; the card's "Busines…" reads as the box edge cutting the column, which the pinned first column, the shadow and the labelled ⤢ now announce.

## Tests

New top-level `describe` in the existing body-table harness, `RelatedList.bodyTable-27055.test.tsx` (the widths stubbed on `HTMLElement.prototype` for the element carrying `data-table-scroll-box`: 120 px per header cell inside a 680 px column; restored in `afterAll`):

- eight columns (hotclm's versions shape): `data-body-table-overflow="true"`, the right shadow present, the first header cell `sticky` and the second not, ⤢ carries `data-overflow="true"` with a visible label and no icon-only `aria-label`, clicking it calls `enlargeRelated('clm_version.contract')`, and the "Business owner" header carries its full label as `title`;
- scrolled to the end (`scrollLeft = scrollWidth - clientWidth`, then a `scroll` event): the trailing shadow clears, the first column stays pinned, overflow still `true`;
- CONTROL: three columns that fit: `data-body-table-overflow="false"`, no shadow, no `sticky` header, the icon-only ⤢ with its `aria-label`;
- the existing #27055 CONTROL (a related list outside the body-table set) now also pins that a plain table's header `span` carries `title="Quantity"`, the reach of the `data-table` change beyond body tables.

**Ablation.** On fix commit `384e15f8`, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the overflow read `setBodyTableOverflows(box.scrollWidth - box.clientWidth > 1)` replaced by `setBodyTableOverflows(false /* ABLATED-29945 */)`: anchor x1 → x0, blob `fc68c4aefa7e` → `6e7dc9971b75`; 2 tests red ("eight columns in the details column…" and "scrolled to the end…"), 13 green (the CONTROL among them). Restored: blob == HEAD `fc68c4aefa7e`, `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports `../RelatedList` from source, so no build sat between the mutation and the run.

## Acceptance notes

- **The right-edge shadow already shipped in 18.3.0.** `npm pack @object-ui/components@18.3.0` carries `data-table-scroll-shadow-right` in `dist/index.js`, so the card's "no visible cue" was measured against a page that had the shadow (a `from-foreground/10` gradient 24 px wide) and a scrollbar that stays transparent until hover. This PR leaves the shared shadow as it is and adds the pinned column and the labelled ⤢; whether the shared shadow itself should be stronger is a `data-table`-wide design call, not taken here.
- **Screenshot at 1440×900: NOT-MEASURED.** Reason: a showcase or hotclm-like boot needs the full workspace build plus the Console build, beyond this card's size; the hotclm evidence paths named on the card are not in this project's shared folder. The behaviour is pinned in jsdom with stubbed widths.
- **Left side.** Once scrolled, the pinned first column's seam (`border-r-2` + shadow, `data-table`'s frozen-column styling) is the left-edge cue; no separate left shadow was added.
- No new spec key; `Metadata-protocol: none`. No change to which column a body table sits in.
- In-flight overlap re-checked at PR time: full-text search of open PRs for `plugin-detail` and `data-table` names none touching `RelatedList.tsx` or `data-table.tsx` (hits: the Version Packages PR and unrelated `plugin-auth` / `spec` / `lint` PRs).
